name: MES SMA(50,200) golden-cross trend-following + 2.0xATR trailing stop (paper strategy)

source.repo_or_note: engine/backtest/trend_signals.py generate_sma_trend_signals() + engine/backtest/paper_config.py MES_TREND_PAPER_CONFIG; gate history PR #552/#598/#691, rank2/rank7/rank11 runs
source.imported_via: pre-existing in engine; seeded into registry 2026-09-12

hypothesis: MES trend-follows: entering long on the 50-SMA/200-SMA golden cross (with a realized-vol >= 9% gate) and holding with a 2.0xATR(14) trailing stop captures the trend with a positive risk-adjusted edge over the 2019-2026 1h sample.

rules.entry: Long only on golden cross (50-SMA crosses above 200-SMA), suppressed when 20-bar annualized realized vol < 9% (MES_MIN_RV_ANNUALIZED=9.0); per engine/backtest/trend_signals.py.
rules.exit: Death cross (50-SMA crosses below 200-SMA) or 2.0xATR(14) trailing stop, whichever first; per trend_signals.py exit path.
rules.position_sizing: risk_per_trade 0.25% of $50K initial capital; 1 concurrent position (MES_TREND_PAPER_CONFIG).
rules.risk_limits: Kill switch -8% daily P&L / -20% drawdown (engine/.env MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT=0.20); gate_v2_policy fail-closes new routing on INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE/FAIL verdicts.
